title: Trade ideas
dek: Inner trade ideas: five trades on one freight regime, sized from a framework that requires 3 to 5 carrier trades a year, plus the bigger-trades candidate pipeline.

claims.text: ICE December 2026 settles on October 19, 2026 (last TMW trading day): TMW -27.50 (0 lots), TMR -1.60 (0 lots), TMS 5.15 (0 lots).

claims.text: S&D model: supply 4,866 kb/d October 2026, 5,167 November (+301 against October) and 5,213 December (+346 against October; December only about 45 kb/d above November); 52 kb/d (November) and 95 kb/d (December) carried as requiring a price response; pipeline spare capacity zero. The step is turnaround returns: the maintenance schedule carries 310 kb/d offline in September, 164 in October, 23 in November, 3 in December, and the model carries no named new-production adds for November or December.

claims.text: Egress strip candidate: short TMW December 2026 to February 2027 (settles -27.50, -26.80, -25.25; 100 lots combined volume, October 19, 2026). Static sizing caps near 120 lots per month at the $1M risk ceiling; carrier scale exists only as a staged build to 425 lots total. The balance model shows pipeline spare capacity positive in every month of 2027, so the candidate is a winter 2026-27 trade.
claims.vintage: ICE settlements October 19, 2026; balance model vintage September 28, 2026
claims.source: ICE Endex report center; WCSB S&D model (Heavy Reading)

claims.text: Diesel crack $102.73 on October 12, 2026, sixth straight day above $100; 34 days above $100 in the validated history; all-time maximum $117.92 (September 16, 2026). The crack ladder candidate arms only on ceasefire confirmation rungs; at 150 to 200 lots and a $20 to $25 realized compression it pays $3.0M to $5.0M.

claims.text: Storage event candidate examined and dropped: the balance model holds inventory flat at 58,720 thousand barrels with 21,896 thousand barrels of ullage in every forecast month through December 2027; no month approaches tank tops.

TMW positioning, CFTC Disaggregated COT report of October 13, 2026: managed money net short 19,415 lots (long 0, short 19,415) against open interest of 77,730; the short is 25.0 percent of open interest against a 146-week median of 1.5 percent; only 4 of 146 reports show managed money more short; net short 43 consecutive weeks; combined managed-money and swap-dealer shorts about 31,598 lots. Crowded short, in the direction of trade 1; the scale path stays shut on this evidence and 75 lots stands.
